_comment: Copy to config.json and edit. Secrets never belong in this file: the Graph client secret and any API secret live in the encrypted store (data/secrets.bin), set with `omni-ingest secrets set graph.client_secret` or from the admin panel.

security._comment: Client networks that may use the MCR panel without signing in. An empty list means everyone signs in. Set this to the newsroom subnet, e.g. ["10.20.0.0/16"]. Replaces the removed `auth_mode`, which opened the panel to every host that could reach the port.

tls._comment: Path to a PKCS#12 (.pfx) certificate holding the certificate and its private key -- the form Windows IT issues. Set the passphrase with `omni-ingest secrets set web.tls_password`. When set, the panels are served over HTTPS and the session cookie gains Secure. Default is plain HTTP on the LAN.

graph._comment: Office 365 mailbox through Microsoft Graph. When tenant_id, client_id, mailbox and the client secret (`omni-ingest secrets set graph.client_secret`) are all set, the mailbox is polled; otherwise email ingest is off. The app needs Mail.Read only; write_access (with Mail.ReadWrite) also marks and files mail under the two folders. See README, 'Office 365 mailbox'.

llm._comment: The deterministic parser decides every job. In "assist" mode the model is asked only when the parser cannot name the journalist of a routed mail or make a keyword from a title, and what it proposes is checked against the roster and ^[A-Z0-9]{2,20}$. "off" never calls it. With the model down the jobs are identical.
